integrity: The theorem is proved algebraically for every finite field of characteristic two. The independent-of-proof finite script checks 224 pairs of exact matrix nullities and exhaustively classifies 4096 configurations of one small torus; no inference from finitely many cases is used to prove the infinite family. No external independent audit has been performed.
limitations: The first torus circumference must be a power of two at least four; the other circumference is any integer at least three. Temporal periods are not quotiented by spatial shifts. The least odd spectral clock is specified by a computable polynomial-gcd condition; no uniform elementary closed formula for it is claimed. Historical equivalence in other literature cannot be excluded.
title: Cyclotomic clocks and uniform Jordan chains in four-neighbor parity tori
